data.title: 芙兰达 · 卧室软床上的贝雷帽卸下温存
data.description: 静谧的卧室内贝雷帽掉在一旁，波浪金发铺散在床单上。粉色透纱娃娃裙被推高，平时不可一世的小恶魔少女此刻满面烧红、双手捂着眼睛害羞求饶，在热烈的深吻中彻底融化。
data.location: dim softly lit private bedroom with ruffled sheets
data.action: pinned on bed with pink babydoll negligee, blonde waves spread on pillow, hands covering blushing face before wrapping around partner neck in surrender
data.lighting: soft warm bedside lamp glow illuminating bare curves and golden hair
data.mood: delightful tsundere meltdown, heated intimate surrender, breathless lovers ecstasy
data.promptProse: Pinned on bed with sheer pink babydoll, blonde Frenda Seivelun blushes furiously, wrapping arms around partner neck with breathless passionate kisses.
